sources.snippet: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) [ˈɒnɪks] [2] is an open-source artificial intelligence ecosystem [3] of technology companies and research organizations that establish open standards for representing machine learning algorithms and software tools to enable a standard format for representing machine learning models.
